name: aircraft
label: Aircraft models
provenance: Wave-1 WS-1 batch 2, added 2026-07-24 on branch claude/next-three-items-nj7dyj. Real aircraft and helicopter model names (Boeing, Airbus, Bombardier, Embraer, Gulfstream, Cessna, Piper, Learjet, Saab, Dassault and others) recalled from general aviation knowledge; not diffed against any manufacturer catalogue or type-certificate register. Mixes alphanumeric designations (Boeing 737, ATR 42-500) with named models (Dreamliner, Super King Air), so 330 of 435 lines contain digits and fail the letters/spaces/hyphens rule in scripts/check_data.py (grandfathered there). 65 of those digits are the character '1', which is absent from data/shared_vocab.json entirely.
